1	# Change context (parent-prepared, factual)
2	
3	## Intent and authority
4	- Source: /tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/claude-candidate-R9-recovery-isolated-1/README.md (blob 6d935949aa8de38a9f440c089a1cab08fc9437db), explicit:
5	  - Accept preference IDs with surrounding whitespace; trim the ID before lookup.
6	  - Preserve the resilient-read contract: up to three attempts on `TransientRead`, return first success;
7	    exhausted transient errors propagate; `MissingPreference` is permanent and must propagate on the first
8	    attempt; reads have no side effects.
9	  - `Preferences.read` is the public entry point; `Repository.read_resilient` owns bounded retry; `read_once`
10	    performs one attempt. Scripted backend models finite outcomes (no sleeping/services/concurrency).
11	  - Python 3.9+, stdlib only. Test command: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
12	- User request: "I've staged the preference ID normalization change." No design/task docs exist (no docs/ directory).
13	
14	## Change boundary
15	- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist.
16	- Review base: HEAD 7c0410c18bac40c33f857000ac3cc59d38a02165 ("Review base").
17	- Candidate: index. Worktree files are identical to the index (no unstaged changes), so worktree paths are the candidate source.
18	  - reader.py index blob 8ae04ed0a21d3aa3355aa58e2d4f152c7ec04fe1 (base blob 9429bec)
19	  - tests/test_reads.py index blob 378ccb85348e46aefae7fa5f96eaac0e772fad92 (base blob 23fc901)
20	- Changed: reader.py (key.strip() before read_resilient), tests/test_reads.py (renamed existing test, added
21	  transient/retry-limit/permanent tests, all using " w ").
22	- Unchanged consumers/dependencies: preferences.py (blob 46fa1bc6...), repository.py (blob b3483bb1...).
23	
24	## Historical evidence
25	- Both base files are fully contained in the diff hunks (reader.py was 2 lines; tests/test_reads.py hunk -1,11
26	  spans the whole base file). No separate historical bundle was needed. No release/deployed baseline is named.
27

29	- Parent ran `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` in the worktree (== index): 4 tests ran, all OK
30	  (test_permanent_error, test_retry_limit, test_transient_error, test_trim_key).
31
